content_sections.heading: Mizoram Soil Conservation Ranger Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: MPSC has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the post of Soil Conservation Ranger. The official notification does not provide a category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC) breakup of these posts. As per the notification, the Soil Conservation Ranger is the head of the lowest departmental establishment at the field level. Key responsibilities include: Identifying priority areas along with subordinate staff for departmental works and schemes. Contacting farmers and keeping them informed of departmental activities. Collecting information on farmers' problems and requirements. Preparing consolidated monthly reports on proposed works and submitting them for scheme implementation, along with suggestions for improvement, to the DSCO. Reporting progress, problems, and difficulties faced during scheme implementation to the DSCO on a monthly basis. Acting as the reporting authority for Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) of all field staff placed under him/her.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Soil Conservation Ranger Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Degree in Forestry, Agriculture, Agriculture Engineering, Horticulture, or Science from a recognized University. Note: The selected candidate must successfully complete Forest Ranger Training from a recognized institution within the probation period. Candidates must meet the Computer Proficiency requirement prescribed under the Mizoram Group 'A', 'B' and 'C' Posts Service/Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2023, notified vide No. A.12018/31/2020-P&AR(GSW) dated 10.03.2023. Details are available at the official reference link shared by MPSC. A candidate must be not less than 18 years and not more than 35 years of age as on 1st August, 2026 . The upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for ST/SC candidates, or as may be notified by the Government from time to time. Accepted proof of age: HSLC/HSSLC Certificates, Voter ID, or Digitized Birth Certificate clearly showing the date of birth. Important: As per UIDAI clarification, the Aadhaar Card is not acceptable as valid proof of date of birth. Candidates must achieve the pass mark in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency as prescribed by the Government from time to time. Exemption: Candidates who studied Mizo as a subject in Class X (HSLC) or above within Mizoram, or who opted for Mizo as MIL (Modern Indian Language) outside Mizoram, are exempted from this qualifying test, as per Mizoram Gazette Notification No. A-11019/1/2021-P&AR(GSW) dated 09.04.2024.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for MPSC Soil Conservation Ranger Recruitment
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following documents on the online portal before the closing date. Documentary support must not be dated later than the last date of application. Marksheets of HSLC and above Educational Certificates of HSLC and above Proof of Computer Proficiency Proof of Mizo Language Proficiency SC/ST Certificate (applicable only to SC/ST candidates) Proof of Date of Birth Proof of educational qualification for the post applied for Any other supporting documents (to be uploaded under the "Others" box/field on the OTR page; multiple documents can be uploaded here) Where the OTR profile requires "Certificate and Marksheet" together, both must be scanned as a single PDF or photographed together clearly before uploading. Uploaded documents must not be password-protected or restricted from viewing/printing — such files will be treated as "not uploaded." Candidature validity will be assessed strictly based on documents uploaded on the online portal. Any request to alter already-uploaded documents must be made well before the last date of application. Alterations made after the last date will not be considered for the post applied for. Failure to upload any mandatory document by the closing date will result in rejection of the application.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for Soil Conservation Ranger in MPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MPSC has announced a total of 5 (five) vacancies for the post of Soil Conservation Ranger under Advertisement No.21 of 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MPSC Soil Conservation Ranger Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 31st August, 2026, up to 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for the Soil Conservation Ranger post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree in Forestry, Agriculture, Agriculture Engineering, Horticulture, or Science from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MPSC Soil Conservation Ranger Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 1st August, 2026, with age relaxation of up to 5 years for ST/SC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Is Aadhaar Card accepted as age proof for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. As per UIDAI clarification, the Aadhaar Card is not accepted as valid proof of date of birth for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. Is Mizo Language Proficiency mandatory for all candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates must pass the Mizo Language Proficiency qualifying test unless they studied Mizo as a subject in Class X (HSLC) or above within Mizoram, or opted for Mizo as MIL outside Mizoram, in which case they are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for MPSC Soil Conservation Ranger Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in after completing One-Time Registration (OTR), followed by document upload and fee payment via UPI.
